text: Kwirinda no kuvura indwara y’Ubushita (Fowl pox)mu nkoko : Iyi ndwara nta muti igira.
Irinde indwara utera usimburanya imiti ikurikira irimo cuwivure (copper) urugero gitenge, komanda na funguran.
● Nyuma yo gusarura ubwa mbere, sarura mu byiciro (akenshi buri cyumweru), kandi ukomeze kwita ku ntoryi , uzuhira .
Amababa y’imbere ni maremare, asa n’igohogo cyijya kweruruka cyangwe n’umuhondo wijimye kandi afite utudomo tujya kwirabura.
Tera ibigori na kokombure hafi y’umurima w’imiteja bizakurura ibinyabwoya bibihugireho kuko bibikurura kurusha imiteja.
Imiti ikoreshwa mu kurwanya uburima bw’umuceri ni nayo ikoreshwa mu kurwanya indwara yo kubabuka k’umuceri.
Ubushakashatsi bwerekanye ko indwara y’Ikivejuru iterwa n’udukoko turuma kumuceli ufite iyo ndwara hanyuma tukaza no kuruma ku muceli utaragerwaho n’ubwandu.

Uko barwanya iyo indwara: umuhinzi atera amoko y’ibireti yihanganira iyo ndwara, guhinga neza bagirira isuku igihingwa, kubisikanya ibireti n’ikindi gihingwa (ibirayi); gutera ingemwe neza ahantu h’ubutaka buhitisha amazi.
